title: skills(objectstack-ai): name the MCP door tool set (MCP_DOOR_TOOL_NAMES) as the fourth tool source once #35036 lands
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUkbQqRUUFSiu2HGob

Filing gate: **(c) a residual a card's review names** — out-of-scope item reported by the #35036 card thread (PR #35458, os-dev-report 7006127433). Lands after PR #35458 merges; until then the current text is still true.

## Gap
- PR #35458 adds `MCP_DOOR_TOOL_NAMES` to `packages/spec` (the MCP door's full tool set, 19 tools measured) and teaches `ai-skill-tool-unresolved` to resolve every one of them for a skill MCP can offer (`mcpPrompt` not `false`).
- `skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md` (around line 84, the numbered list of tool sources) still names only `MCP_FILE_TOOL_NAMES` as the fourth source. After #35458 an author reading the skill would think `query_records`, `delete_records` and the other door tools still warn, and would rename a correct claim.

## Scope
- Rewrite source 4 of that list to name `MCP_DOOR_TOOL_NAMES` (file tools included), and keep the `mcpPrompt: false` condition and the dedicated hint for a door-only name on an in-product-only skill.
- Check the same list's wording in any eval or rule file under `skills/objectstack-ai/**` that quotes it.
- ⛔ Text only; no change to the rule or the constant.

## Reader
`domain:skills` (governed text, Tier S/H per the path fork). Suggested grade: p3 (documentation following a landed implementation).
